paragraphs: Mentioned in the Zohar, at the beginning of Idra Zuta, Haazinu; he was in the presence of R' Shimon ben Yochai.[^1][^2]

notes.text: רש״בי is read contextually as Shimon ben Yochai, with personal title component R', rather than automatic Rabbi. The heading title likewise remains R'.

ריש gives beginning of Idra Zuta, Haazinu; no modern locator is added or independently checked against a named edition. לפני means in the presence of, not chronologically before; the subject is understood from the heading.
